title: Noun Declensions — i-Stems and u-Stems
subtitle: Giest, sunu, duru — minor classes, common words.
objectives: Master Noun Declensions — i-Stems and u-Stems.
Read and translate authentic Old English poetry and prose.

sections.heading: Content
sections.body: The i-stem and u-stem declensions are smaller than the a-stem and ō-stem classes, but they include common words. Giest (guest), sunu (son), duru (door), feld (field), wine (friend). The u-stems have -u throughout; the i-stems often merge with a-stems in later Old English.
